Thanks for the context — quick feasibility notes and MAP draft below. High-level: all asks are feasible but will map to two tracks (Hosted Dedicated vs Private).

Feasibility summary:
- GLBA addendum: Legal can produce a GLBA-specific addendum based on our regulated-vertical template. We will incorporate the restricted-use language and a standard tech stack description.
- BAA: We have a BAA appendix; legal to confirm minor scoping changes for claims PHI (this usually adds 3–4 business days for review). Pricing for BAA-scoped workloads is incremental (revenue-based).
- SCCs / transfers: We support SCCs by default; EU-hosted Dedicated pools are available for accounts that require residency.
- Subprocessor exclusion: For Dedicated customers we can support a limited exclusion list (we cannot remove cloud infra providers, but we can limit third-party analytics/monitoring agents). - 72-hour breach notification: Legal confirms we can commit to 72 hours for confirmed incidents with standard exceptions for investigation windows; we will mirror that in the DPA.
